query: (Cathay MD) Build a model to organise/optimise routes and service so Overall Rating > 7.

per_column.name: primary_complaint_category
per_column.rationale: A strong new grouping axis for diagnosing what drags Overall Rating down, directly relevant to a service/route optimization model. However, the 'staff_service' label appears to tag salient topic rather than an actual complaint: rows 3, 4 and 5 are reviews that PRAISE staff and complain about seats/food, yet are labeled staff_service as the primary complaint. That conflation contradicts the source text and weakens groundedness.

per_column.name: seat_comfort_physical_limitation
per_column.rationale: Adds a specific physical-limitation angle (cramped legroom, recline) beyond the raw Seat Comfort rating, useful for cabin/product decisions. Mostly grounded (row 4 'cramped' -> True is correct, silent rows -> null is fine), but row 5 explicitly says business seats 'hardly recline at all' yet is labeled False, a direct contradiction of the text.

per_column.name: staff_service_attentiveness_gap
per_column.rationale: A clean binary service-quality axis relevant to the optimization goal; partially overlaps Staff Service rating and primary_complaint_category but still a distinct modeling feature. Sample values are well supported (no help -> True; praised crew -> False), though row 2 (no advance notice of gate change) is arguably a gap yet marked False.

per_column.name: food_beverage_quality
per_column.rationale: Provides a categorical read of catering that is largely redundant with the existing Food & Beverages rating, limiting new leverage, though the graded categories add some nuance. Values are reasonably grounded; silent rows -> Unknown is correct behaviour, though row 4 ('great food options') mapped to 'adequate' understates the text.

per_column.name: operational_reliability_issue
per_column.rationale: Highly useful for route/operations optimization, giving a categorical reliability signal not present in the originals. Delay/diversion cases are correctly captured, but 'on_time_reliable' is assigned to a very large 577-row bucket including reviews that never mention punctuality (rows 3-5), asserting a confident specific where the text is silent rather than using unknown.

per_column.name: service_recovery_failure
per_column.rationale: A genuinely distinct axis (did the airline recover after a problem) that is actionable for the MD's service model. Sample values are well grounded: no reply/no assistance -> True, positive reviews -> False.

per_column.name: cabin_class_experience_gap
per_column.rationale: Conceptually useful for class/product decisions, and row 5 (regional A330 business 'very poor') -> premium_poor is well grounded. But rows 1 and 2 are about ground handling and a delay with no cabin-class content, yet are confidently labeled 'economy_poor' — invented specifics unsupported by the text.

per_column.name: route_length_discomfort_interaction
per_column.rationale: Directly on-point for the route-optimization query, combining haul length with discomfort into a groupable feature. Route length is a warranted inference from the Route column, but row 4 (Hong Kong to Melbourne, a ~9h long-haul) is labeled 'short_haul_acceptable', which contradicts the derivable distance; the 'discomfort' half is also inferred beyond what silent rows state.

per_column.name: traveller_expectation_segment
per_column.rationale: Largely re-derives the existing 'Type of Traveller' column, so it adds limited new leverage. Groundedness is weak in the samples: rows 1 and 2 are assigned 'business_high_expectation' and row 5 'family_mixed' with no textual support for those traveller types, reading as arbitrary/invented segment labels.

judge.rationale: As a set, these columns give the Cathay MD several genuinely new modeling axes—complaint category, operational reliability, service-recovery failure, route-length interaction, and cabin-class gap—that are well aligned with optimizing routes/service toward Overall Rating > 7; a couple (traveller_expectation_segment, food_beverage_quality) largely restate existing original columns and add less leverage. Groundedness is the weaker dimension: while extractions for problem-focused rows are sound and silent-row 'Unknown/null' is handled correctly, multiple columns assert confident specifics where the text is silent or contradicts it (economy_poor for a ground-handling/delay review, a long-haul route mislabeled short_haul, arbitrary business/family segments, and positive reviews tagged as staff-service complaints), so several fields show observable hallucination.
